A SURFHOUSE WITH A SOUL

A little less hotel.
A little more home.

Some places give you a bed.
Others give you a feeling.

We’re Crew Lopez. A home for ocean lovers, curious travellers and anyone who believes the best part of a trip is the people you meet along the way.

Our new villa in Lajares puts village life within walking distance, with nature all around, a green garden, a swimming pool and peaceful outdoor spaces. Breakfast, yoga, community and bikes to use are included in your stay.

THE CREW LOPEZ JOURNAL

Notes from
the island.

Surf life, shared moments and a little inspiration for the road. Open a story and stay a while.

Your first day with the crew

Community

Drop your bags. Pull up a chair. Let the island set the pace.

Start by settling into the house and saying hello to the people around you. Find the shared kitchen, choose a spot for your morning coffee and ask the crew what is happening during your stay.

Dinner together is an easy way to get to know your fellow guests. Bring a story, listen to someone else’s and see where the conversation takes you.

A little preparation for your surf trip

Surf life

Pack light, bring curiosity and leave room for the unexpected.

Bring comfortable layers, sun protection, a reusable water bottle and something warm for the evening. Ask your activity provider about boards, wetsuits and anything else you need before booking a session.

Be honest about your experience. A suitable lesson and good local advice make a better start than chasing the biggest wave. Follow your instructor and give yourself time to learn.

Take the slow way

Island life

Some of the best days have very little on the schedule.

Make room for an unplanned morning. Walk into the village, stop for coffee and ask someone at the house about their favourite place to spend an afternoon.

You do not need to fit everything into one visit. Pick one thing you want to do, leave time to rest and enjoy the people you meet along the way.

A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

Before you come.

How do I book?

Choose your dates and bed on Booking.com. You’ll find live availability, prices and the terms for your stay there.

Can I come on my own?

Absolutely. Our shared accommodation and common spaces make it easy to meet other travellers while keeping your own rhythm.

When can I check in?

Check-in is from 14:00 to 22:00, and check-out is by 11:00. Confirm arrival arrangements with the property through your booking.

What’s included in my stay?

Breakfast, yoga, community and bikes to use are included. Enjoy the swimming pool, green garden and peaceful outdoor spaces. Dinner is available as an optional paid extra.

Have another question?

Use the property contact options on Booking.com. If you’ve already booked, you can message the crew through your reservation.

Change your choice

Other websites
